ESPMO Auto Generator

Asset Library

Reads the Profiler Engagement Matrix, locates the required templates, fills the approved fields, and produces draft governance documents for review. Runs entirely in your browser — no upload, no server, no login.

1 Load source file(s) Profiler Engagement Matrix (.xlsx) and optional TRT Recommendation (.docx, .pptx, or .xlsx)
▦
Drop the project's Profiler Engagement Matrix (.xlsx) and optional TRT Recommendation (.docx, .pptx, or .xlsx) here, or click to choose
Use either file or both. The Engagement Matrix supplies the tier, zone, required documents, and ownership path; the TRT Recommendation can add disposition, conditions, and governance details.
Or paste a TRT Recommendation as text
Paste the TRT Recommendation text below — it loads automatically the moment you paste. Clear headings and body text help the Auto Generator prefill the appropriate templates.
2 Load template assets waiting for the source file
Select the synced Teams library folder that contains the templates. Subfolders are searched after folder access is granted.
⚠ Folder picker note
Windows may show only subfolders, not the .docx files inside. Open the correct folder and choose Select Folder; the tool reads the templates after access is granted.
⊞
Drop the required .docx templates here, or click to choose
Use the Teams Files tab, downloaded templates, or a synced library folder. Select the templates named by the Engagement Matrix.
3 Generate draft documents choose an output format
Choose a project working folder you control. Drafts are saved there for review before final documents are uploaded to the official SharePoint location.
Narrative sections are marked with [DRAFT WITH COPILOT: …] placeholders. Open each draft in Word, review the cue, and use Copilot only where a narrative response needs to be drafted or refined within the tenant.
Load the source file and required templates to begin.
